eviction_and_lifetime: Full next map is installed before capacity eviction, preventing arbitrary owner-key admission from pre-dropping a hot new product. Newly seen non-event products start cold, actual events move only still-retained handles to newest.

Single oversize allocations are removed before other LRU victims, preventing them from expelling every useful small item before being discarded. Union capacity is recomputed after each allocation removal from all epochs.
